notes.title: Summer Event in Zoo 2: Animal Park
notes.content: [p]During the event, you set up matching decorations and collect suns. In addition to exclusive decorations and chests, two animals await you as rewards.[/p][p]You can earn two copies of the Greater Hog Badger and the red color variant of the European Badger.[/p][p]The summer event runs until July 8 at 12 pm CEST.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38414568/c6c4caff2aae594f0386f011073031df58fd9b2f.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Zoo 2: Animal Park - Rehab Station
notes.content:
In Zoo 2: Animal Park you can now take in sick animals and nurse them back to health in the brand new Rehab Station! There you can lovingly care for injured or orphaned animals, help them recover and then decide whether to release them into the wild or take them permanently into your zoo.

Three animals are waiting for you every day in the new store at the sanctuary - including exclusive species that can only be found there: for example the lop rabbit, the cape fox or the leopard tortoise.

[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0520_2025_Zoo2_rehab_station_640_250.jpg[/img]

The Rehab Station is an optional feature for all players from level 100 – and perfect if you want to level up faster: Rescued animals earn you a lot of XP when they are released into the wild, and even 1.5 times the experience points in the zoo!

💎 Tip: A cashback campaign is currently running in the game: Until May 26 at 12 pm CET, you can get up to 25 percent of your diamonds back!

👉 Discover the sanctuary now and save animals!

notes.title: Zoo 2: Animal Park - Mother's Day Event
notes.content:
You can set up decorations such as the map arch or the hedgehog ball and regularly receive crowns for doing so until May 14 at 12 noon. You can earn several chests, decorations and two animals as rewards. The flamingo in the new color variant coral and the Schleswig Coldblood.

[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0430_2025_Zoo2_mothersday_event_640_250.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Zoo 2: Animal Park - Season Pass
notes.content:
We are celebrating the seventh birthday of Zoo 2: Animal Park and are delighted to introduce the new feature: the Season Pass! You'll complete weekly tasks, answer quiz questions and advance through the Season Pass levels.

Of course, your progress will be rewarded. Take a look at the different levels directly in the game. Also brand new are the enclosures, which allow you to customize the enclosures in your zoos even further.

[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0327_2025_Zoo2_season_pass_640_250.jpg[/img]

We are also launching a breeding campaign. Until March 29 at 12 noon, all your animals are guaranteed to give birth to triplets if their attempts are successful.

[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0327_2024_Zoo2_anniversary_breeding_640x250.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Valentine's Day Event 2025
notes.content:
Some people say go big or go home when it comes to romance. We're in the "go home" camp this year, preferring a quiet day in the garden with the people we love instead of grand journeys to far off places!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38414568/3c25c47c33c6f3ab27fb891a9706899a3760440a.jpg[/img]

The seasonal section of the shop has been stocked with charming [b]garden decorations[/b] - enjoy watching doves playing in the bird bath, admire roses creeping up wrought iron garden obelisks and stay in an enchanting cottage!

Purchase and place lovely event decorations from now until [b]February 12[/b] at 11:59 am CET and collect Roses from these at regular intervals; just click on the pins that appear over the decorations to collect them!

You'll be able to redeem your Roses for a number of [b]tantalizing prizes[/b], including a well-supplied Flower Vendor, a romantic Garden Breakfast, and a brand-new animal for your zoo, the Galah!

Last year's Valentine's decorations have also been added to the club shop, allowing you to create an even more romantic atmosphere.

[u][b]Need more Roses?[/b][/u] We've got you covered: you can purchase missing Roses for Diamonds in the event window until the redemption phase ends on February 19, 2025!

notes.title: Fun in the Snow
notes.content:
DUCK! You better watch out - rogue snowballs have been pelting animals and innocent zoogoers alike. It's up to you to rein in the chaos and make sure everyone enjoys the snow!

Record snowfall has turned the zoo into a winter wonderland - but not everyone's in it for the scenery!
There's snowball fights to be had, and hills to sled down - help create a safe space for the kids to play, without endangering your less-adventurous visitors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38414568/55002a03c0e8f8981e0becaccf758e5dc906457c.jpg[/img]

The seasonal section of the shop has been filled with everything you need for a fun day in the snow!

Build snow forts, set up bird feeders, and ready the sleds from now until December 20 at 11:59 am CET. Each event decoration will generate Snowflakes for you to collect at regularly - just click on the pins that appear over them to collect them!

Redeem your Snowflakes for super cool new decorations, including a whole sledding hill, wintery info signs, a hiker's shelter and a brand-new species for your zoo, the African Penguin!

Short on Snowflakes? No need to worry - you can buy extra for Diamonds until the redemption phase ends on January 3, 2023!

If you're looking for even more winter decorations, be sure to swing by the Club Shop, which now has all of the previous' years winter decorations too!

notes.title: Ocean Deep Dive
notes.content:
A former marine research center, this new zoo lets you create a coastal paradise for your critters - with all-new decorations and ocean-themed versions of all the usual amenities. It also comes with some special features!

Players level 70 and up can now unlock the brand-new Oceanside Zoo on their world map for 150 Diamonds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38414568/32cf953fc6ea5f8740fe6cfba537e04d34f715f4.jpg[/img]

But that's not all!

Black Friday is here, and with it, a sensational sale, a new region, and an unbelievable line-up of new bonus animals!
We're going wild for Black Friday - with a phenomenal sale, and a whole new zoo for you to explore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38414568/8443cc5b4baf9d0d060e628214406bec9b50f268.jpg[/img]

Once again, we're hosting a super sale for the occasion, during which you'll have the chance to earn back a percentage of the Diamonds you spend in the game. This is a great chance to save on fancy decorations, enclosures, equipment, staff, Zoo Academy memberships and more!

The more you spend, the more you save - you can get up to 25% of the Diamonds you spend back!

notes.title: Halloween Event
notes.content:
A little mishap with the garden hose... and BAM: you have yourself a clever theme for Halloween.
Help Lucy and Gavin figure out what's haunting the zoo in this year's Halloween event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38414568/ea80e9d5e49571b212366938cabcfbd1946dea06.jpg[/img]

As always, you'll find the seasonal section of the shop filled with dreadfully delightful decorations. Stock up on swampy branches, logs, and even a witch's hut from now until November 1st at 11:59 am CET.

Set these up in your zoo and collect Pumpkins from them at regular intervals - just click on the pins that appear over them!

Redeem your Pumpkins for petrifyingly perfect prizes, including a brand-new species for your zoo, the Reticulated Python and an impressive Swamp Cypress! If you're running low on Pumpkins, you can always purchase more in the event window for Diamonds - even once the collection phase has ended. Just make sure to redeem all of your Pumpkins for prizes before November 7.

We've also added a new terrain to the Terrain Editor. Give your zoo a spooky make-over with the brand-new Swamp terrain! And of course, decorations from last year's Halloween event are now available in the Club Shop.
